investigate.conclusion:
Yes. In `inject`, when `sampled` is `None`, the code sets `carrier[_SAMPLED]` to the integer `1`.

Relevant lines:

```python
sampled = baggage.pop(_SAMPLED, None)

if sampled is None:
    carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1
else:
    ...
```

- `sampled = baggage.pop(_SAMPLED, None)` — pulls the sampled value out of baggage, defaulting to `None`.
- `if sampled is None:` — the branch taken when no sampled value was present.
- `carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1` — assigns the integer literal `1` (not the string `"1"`, not `True`) to the `x-b3-sampled` header.

Note there is a second place that also assigns `carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1`: the later guard

```python
if sampled is flags is (traceid and spanid) is None:
    warn(...)
    carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1
```

That one fires only when `sampled`, `flags`, and `(traceid and spanid)` are all `None` (i.e., nothing meaningful is being propagated), and it likewise writes the integer `1`. So in both cases the value written is the integer `1`.

For text files, output is truncated to 2000 lines or 50KB (whichever is hit first). Use offset/limit for large files. When you need the full file, continue with offset until complete.

path.description: Path to the file to read (relative or absolute)

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (1-indexed)

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read

content.text: Investigate this question about lightstep/b3_propagator.py: When `sampled` is None, does the code set `carrier[_SAMPLED]` to the integer `1`? Read the relevant code and explain what you find, citing the lines. Do not return JSON yet.

messages.content: I'll investigate the file.

Yes. In `inject`, when `sampled` is `None`, the code sets `carrier[_SAMPLED]` to the integer `1`.

Relevant lines:

```python
sampled = baggage.pop(_SAMPLED, None)

if sampled is None:
    carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1
else:
    ...
```

- `sampled = baggage.pop(_SAMPLED, None)` — pulls the sampled value out of baggage, defaulting to `None`.
- `if sampled is None:` — the branch taken when no sampled value was present.
- `carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1` — assigns the integer literal `1` (not the string `"1"`, not `True`) to the `x-b3-sampled` header.

Note there is a second place that also assigns `carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1`: the later guard

```python
if sampled is flags is (traceid and spanid) is None:
    warn(...)
    carrier[_SAMPLED] = 1
```

That one fires only when `sampled`, `flags`, and `(traceid and spanid)` are all `None` (i.e., nothing meaningful is being propagated), and it likewise writes the integer `1`. So in both cases the value written is the integer `1`.
